summary: Frontend-only validation of the Performance+Efficiency -> 'Analyse flotte' fusion. Navigation now shows exactly 6 tabs (tab-overview, tab-analyse, tab-drivers, tab-vehicles, tab-costs, tab-iot); tab-performance and tab-efficiency no longer exist. The Analyse flotte tab renders analytical indicators (5/12, 7, 2, 3, 251 km) with NO duplication of Vue generale KPIs (Utilisation moyenne, Distance totale, Heures moteur are absent). Info tooltips work, category bar segments are interactive and filter the table, chart 'Vehicules utilises par jour (%)' renders, 5 filter buttons work with counts, sortable table toggles asc/desc on header click (verified with Distance column: default '0 km'... -> desc '935.6, 879.2, 838.5'... -> asc '0 km'...), 'vs moy. flotte' column shows +/- pts, row click opens drawer with stats, fleet comparison, activity-per-day calendar (7 day cards) and daily bar chart. Insights are actionable and clicking insight-0 sets filter to 'inactif' correctly. Overview tab still exposes 6 KPI cards with drawers; drawer navigation links now point to 'analyse' (labels 'Analyse flotte' / 'Analyse complete'), no 'Performance'/'Efficacite' link remains. Other tabs (drivers/vehicles/costs/iot) navigate without errors. Backend /api/fleet/efficiency still returns success=true with active_day_threshold_km=1.0, summary.categories dict and per-vehicle daily_breakdown length==7.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyseFlotteTab.jsx L212 sort uses `va > vb ? 1 : -1` which returns -1 when values are equal (unstable). Prefer numeric subtraction / localeCompare (already flagged in iteration 7 for EfficiencyTab and copied here).

AnalyseFlotteTab.jsx L208 groups 'bonne' with 'tres_utilise' under both filter ids 'bonne' and 'fort'. The 'bonne' filter therefore does not restrict to strictly 'bonne' anymore; either remove that alias or split into two filters for clarity.

AnalyseFlotteTab.jsx L164 label says 'Fortement utilises' with definition '>= 60%' but the underlying set is bonne+tres_utilise (>=60%). Definition and label are consistent; however the category CATEGORIES[4].label='Forte' (85+) differs from the KPI wording 'Fortement utilises' (60+). Consider harmonizing terminology to avoid confusion between KPI and category chip.

PerformanceTab.jsx and EfficiencyTab.jsx are still present on disk but no longer imported. Delete or clearly archive to prevent accidental reuse and reduce bundle noise on next build tree-shake changes.
